gen-gf-bellota-gf-commissioner: Distinctive is the word for Bellota, with its far-hanging s and a line traced at the width of one stylus, while Commissioner reads smoothly below. Try a generous heading size.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-didact-gothic: Commanding from the first word, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine, and Didact Gothic below it never snags on a closed-up bowl. A big heading size would show it off.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads approachably, its wide channels leading into every counter. Bellota above it is the distinctive one, an s with ends hanging far from the spine, and that display flair against the sans body is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-doto: Approachable and modern, Doto leaves wide margins of space around each glyph and generous mouths on its round letters. Bellota does the showing off, with a w of no thick or thin strokes, and Doto does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri reads clean and modern, with a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot between the c's two ends. Bellota, by contrast, keeps a flat, unvarying line weight in every letter, and that flat heading against a gently contrasted sans-serif is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-electrolize: Modern and contemporary, Electrolize opens its c like a pair of pliers, while Bellota above it keeps a blueprint-lettering feel of constant line. Over a long passage, the sans-serif body should read crisply.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-elms-sans: Contemporary and unfussy, Elms Sans has the pressure-free line of a ballpoint and a gap you can see through in each s, under Bellota's distinctive heading. A long stretch of it reads like plain sans.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans reads clean, with gaps that keep c from looking like o, and it sits below a plain sans-minded stranger. And Bellota, with no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning, gives the page a headline voice that the body never competes with.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Bellota's most distinctive trait is its every stroke drawn at one thickness, topped by an s with ends hanging far from the spine. And Encode Sans Expanded, with its c shapes pulled well apart, would read steadily and openly across a long passage.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-sc: Bellota draws its letters with a single constant line width, and its s ends hang far from the spine for a commanding look. Encode Sans SC, with a shallow terminal curl and wide gap, handles the plain sans reading.
